verdict.rationale: Gusto's official CLI documents that its API requests carry anonymous usage headers (X-Gusto-CLI-Install-Id, X-Gusto-CLI-Command) and that setting GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 omits both, a first-party telemetry opt-out on the agent-facing surface. The evidence is a single README mention scoped to the CLI. missing for 10: telemetry opt-out coverage for other surfaces (MCP server, React SDK, web app), fuller documentation of what usage data is collected, independent or hands-on verification that the opt-out works
